hooks.command: jq -r '.user_prompt // ""' | grep -q '?' && echo '{"systemMessage":"Question detected — Claude must discuss, not act.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"STOP. The user asked a question (their message contains \"?\"). This is a HARD CONSTRAINT: you MUST NOT call Edit, Write, Bash, or any code-modifying tool in your next response. You MUST only think and discuss. Respond with text only. If you catch yourself about to call a tool, STOP and answer with words instead. Violating this rule is a critical failure."}}' || true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in *.java) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"REMINDER: Have you loaded the bulma-java skill this session? If not, stop and invoke it before editing Java files."}}' ;; esac
